title: Short title.
bodyText: This chapter shall be known and may be cited as the Geothermal and Cable System Development Permitting Act of 1988.
bodyHtml: [§196D-1]  Short title.  This chapter shall be known and may be cited as the Geothermal and Cable System Development Permitting Act of 1988. [L 1988, c 301, pt of §1]
